Subject: eight INNOVATIVE evolutions of the attached icon concept \u2014 a listening dial: a ring of rounded capsule bars (green arc above, ink arc below) around a solid green centre dot. Preserve exactly that DNA in every cell: the capsule-bar ring, the green-and-ink duality, the centre dot, flat geometric vector, even stroke weight, rounded terminals, bold at 16 pixels. Change one idea per cell: 1 SPLIT-VOICE \u2014 the left half of the ring is straight ink text rules, the right half is green sound capsules, page becomes voice inside the circle \u00b7 2 ECHO TRAIL \u2014 the ring drawn as three offset rotations of itself fading behind, like motion echo, dot fixed \u00b7 3 NEGATIVE TAIL \u2014 the lower ink capsules arrange so the empty gap between them reads as a small speech-bubble tail \u00b7 4 APERTURE BLADES \u2014 the capsules tilt and spiral like camera-aperture blades closing toward the dot \u00b7 5 DOUBLE RIPPLE \u2014 two concentric capsule rings, inner green outer ink, dot at centre \u00b7 6 PLAYHEAD \u2014 the ring has a gap at twelve o'clock and one green capsule becomes an indicator marker on the ring \u00b7 7 PAGE FOLD \u2014 the lower ink capsules cluster like a folded page corner that curves upward and becomes the green listening arc \u00b7 8 ONE-BAR MORPH \u2014 a single ink text rule enters the ring at nine o'clock and exits at three o'clock as ascending green capsules.
Use case: bold brand concept sheet; the size strip below renders variants 1 and 5 at 16, 32 and 64 pixels.
Constraints: exactly three colours \u2014 ink #F8F8F9, accent #21F299, navy #010616 \u2014 no other colours; no gradients, no glow, no 3D, no shadows; no letters, no words, no watermark; tiny monospace numerals 1-8 may label the cells; each cell must remain a single compact glyph, not a scene.
